original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Produce ONE coherent HEAD-AND-SHOULDERS THREE-VIEW CHARACTER TURNAROUND SHEET of the exact adult character in the reference. Three evenly spaced panels horizontally, left to right: EXACT FRONT (0 degrees), EXACT SIDE PROFILE looking to screen right (90 degrees), EXACT BACK OF HEAD AND SHOULDERS (180 degrees). All three are rotations of ONE identical head, same skull size, same eye level, shoulder baseline, same camera distance and magnification. Frame full hair, neck, shoulders and upper chest, no cropped crown, no full body. Back view shows only back of head, no cheek or eye; side must be strict profile not three-quarter. Preserve face bone structure, eyes, nose, jaw, age, skin tone, hairstyle and color, clothing neckline and accessories EXACTLY. Do not beautify into a new face. Premium otome 2.5D/3D rendering EXACTLY as supplied portrait: crisp fine strand hair, detailed skin shading, dimensional sculpted features, textured cloth; white seamless background and soft neutral frontal studio lighting, equal brightness across panels. Landscape 3:2, highest available detail. Three separate busts with white gaps, no overlapping, no labels, no text or borders. This is a production continuity reference, not three different people.
